abstract: This article introduces an iterative distributed computing (IDC) estimator for the multinomial logistic regression model with large choice sets. The IDC estimator reformulates the estimation problem as a sequence of structured, low-dimensional subproblems that can be solved efficiently and in parallel. We establish that, when initialized with a consistent estimator, the IDC estimator is asymptotically equivalent to the maximum likelihood estimator and achieves asymptotic efficiency under a weak dominance condition. We further develop a parametric bootstrap procedure for inference based on the IDC estimator and prove its consistency. Extensive simulation studies validate the effectiveness of the proposed methods and highlight the computational efficiency of the IDC estimator.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种适用于大选择集多项逻辑回归模型的迭代分布式计算（IDC）估计量。IDC估计量将估计问题重构为一系列结构化、低维的子问题，这些子问题可高效并行求解。我们证明，在初始化为一致估计量的条件下，IDC估计量与最大似然估计量渐近等价，并在弱支配条件下实现渐近有效性。我们进一步开发了一种基于IDC估计量的参数自助法推断程序，并证明了其一致性。广泛的模拟研究验证了所提方法的有效性，并凸显了IDC估计量的计算效率。

title: Instrument Hacking

authors: Michael P. Keane, Timothy Neal, Patrick Vu
official: 官方在线 2026-08-24 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: In instrumental-variable (IV) studies, researchers often evaluate multiple candidate instruments and selectively report the specification with the most favorable first- or second-stage statistics. We show that this form of instrument selection (“instrument-hacking”) induces median bias in IV estimators toward the OLS estimand, undermining the rationale for using IV. When all candidate instruments have the same true strength, median bias increases monotonically with the number of available instruments. More generally, when candidate instruments differ in true strength, monotonicity need not hold because increasing the number of instruments can lead researchers to select genuinely stronger instruments. Nonetheless, in simulations calibrated to the empirical distribution of instrument strengths in the IV literature, median bias increases monotonically with the number of available instruments. Furthermore, it is substantial in magnitude, even when only a few instruments are available.
abstract_zh: 在工具变量（IV）研究中，研究者常评估多个候选工具变量，并选择性地报告一阶段或二阶段统计量最有利的规格。我们证明，这种工具选择形式（“工具操纵”）会导致IV估计量向OLS估计量产生中位数偏误，削弱了使用IV的合理性。当所有候选工具变量具有相同的真实强度时，中位数偏误随可用工具数量的增加而单调递增。更一般地，当候选工具变量在真实强度上存在差异时，单调性不一定成立，因为增加工具数量可能促使研究者选择真正更强的工具。然而，在基于IV文献中工具强度经验分布校准的模拟中，中位数偏误随可用工具数量的增加而单调递增。此外，即使仅有少量工具可用，其偏误幅度也相当可观。

title: The Conquest of Israeli Inflation and Current Policy Dilemmas
title_zh: 以色列通胀的治理与当前政策困境

title_secondary: The Conquest of Israeli Inflation and Current Policy Dilemmas
authors: Alex Cukierman, Rafi Melnick
official: 官方在线 2015-11-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: During the five decades since the creation of the Bank of Israel in 1954 Israel experienced high and extremely variable inflation. Price stability (as defined by current international norms) was finally achieved at the beginning of the twenty first century. The paper divides the 1954-2015 sample into six sub-periods characterized by different inflation environments. The first part of the paper documents the impact of those different inflation environments on the average speed of individual price adjustments, the related pass-through from the exchange rate to domestic prices, inflation uncertainty, the extent of dollarization, relative price variability and the cost and time to maturity of the public debt. There are major quantitative differences in the above mentioned variables between the five inflationary sub-periods and the more recent price stability period. Among those are dramatic changes in the anchoring of inflation expectations, in the pass-through coefficient, inflation uncertainty, the speed of price adjustments, relative price variability, the (rather late) disappearance of dollarization in the real estate market and the benefits induced by price stability for the financing of the public debt. The paper provides an explanation for the fact that high inflation was stabilized in ?one shot? while the subsequent moderate inflation was stabilized gradually within an inflation targeting framework. It argues that the second stabilization fits into the mold of the opportunistic approach to disinflation. The second part of the paper focuses solely on the period of price stability. It documents major, non-inflation related, structural changes since the turn of the century and discusses current policy dilemmas. Among the major structural changes are a persistent switch from current account deficits to surpluses, increased flexibility in the labor market, a reduction in the size of government, separation of pension and provident funds from the banking system and the emergence of a corporate bond market. Particularly remarkable is the macroeconomic resilience of the Israeli economy to the world financial crisis. As in many developed economies both the inflation gap and the output gap are recently in the negative range implying that, on both counts, monetary policy should be expansionary. The current policy rate is indeed almost at the zero bound. On one hand this policy, along with occasional interventions in the forex market, partially offsets overvaluation pressures on the exchange rate. On the other it reinforces a nine year long cycle of price increases in the real estate market.
abstract_zh: 自1954年以色列银行成立以来的五十年间，以色列经历了高且波动剧烈的通货膨胀。直至二十一世纪初，才最终实现了价格稳定（按当前国际标准定义）。本文将1954年至2015年的样本划分为六个具有不同通胀环境的子时期。论文第一部分记录了这些不同通胀环境对个体价格调整平均速度、汇率对国内价格的传导效应、通胀不确定性、美元化程度、相对价格变动性以及公共债务成本与到期期限的影响。在五个通胀子时期与近期的价格稳定时期之间，上述变量存在显著的定量差异。其中包括通胀预期锚定的剧烈变化、传导系数、通胀不确定性、价格调整速度、相对价格变动性、房地产市场美元化（较晚）的消失，以及价格稳定对公共债务融资带来的益处。本文解释了为何高通胀得以“一次性”稳定，而随后的温和通胀则在通胀目标框架内逐步稳定的现象，并认为第二次稳定符合机会主义式反通胀方法的模式。论文第二部分仅聚焦于价格稳定时期，记录了自世纪之交以来与通胀无关的重大结构性变化，并讨论了当前的政策困境。主要的结构性变化包括：经常账户从赤字持续转向盈余、劳动力市场灵活性增强、政府规模缩减、养老金和公积金基金与银行体系分离，以及公司债券市场的兴起。尤为显著的是以色列经济对世界金融危机的宏观韧性。与许多发达经济体一样，近期的通胀缺口和产出缺口均为负值，这意味着从两方面看，货币政策都应采取扩张性立场。当前政策利率确实几乎处于零下限。一方面，这一政策加上对外汇市场的偶尔干预，部分抵消了汇率高估的压力；另一方面，它也加剧了房地产市场长达九年的价格上涨周期。

title: Global Dollar Exposure and Its Relationship with CIP Deviations
title_zh: 全球美元敞口及其与CIP偏差的关系
title_primary: 全球美元敞口及其与CIP偏差的关系
title_secondary: Global Dollar Exposure and Its Relationship with CIP Deviations
authors: Zixuan Huang & Mr. Aki Yokoyama
official: 官方在线 2026-08-14 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper analyzes a global map of dollar exposures and examines the relationship between net dollar exposures, defined as the difference between dollar assets and liabilities, and covered interest parity (CIP) deviations. We find that the cross-sectional relationship is significantly negative in advanced economies but positive in emerging markets. CIP deviations represent the hedging cost that foreign holders of dollar assets or liabilities incur to manage exchange rate risk. To explain, we develop a model in which the CIP deviations are determined by the demand and the supply side of hedging. The negative correlation in advanced economies can be explained by the variations in hedging demand. Larger net dollar exposures increase the hedging demand, raising hedging costs (reflected as more negative CIP deviations) and producing a negative correlation. In contrast, the positive correlation in emerging markets is explained by the supply side of the hedging market. Limited hedging supply leads to wider CIP deviations (more negative), encouraging firms to borrow in U.S. dollars rather than local currencies, thereby reducing net dollar exposures and generating a positive correlation.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了全球美元敞口分布图，并考察了净美元敞口（定义为美元资产与负债之差）与套息平价（CIP）偏离之间的关系。我们发现，在发达经济体中，这一横截面关系显著为负，而在新兴市场中则为正。CIP偏离代表了美元资产或负债的外国持有者为管理汇率风险而产生的对冲成本。为解释这一现象，我们构建了一个模型，其中CIP偏离由对冲需求方和供给方共同决定。发达经济体中的负相关可由对冲需求的变动来解释。较大的净美元敞口增加对冲需求，推高对冲成本（表现为更负的CIP偏离），从而产生负相关关系。相反，新兴市场中的正相关则由对冲市场的供给方解释。有限的对冲供给导致CIP偏离扩大（更负），促使企业以美元而非本币借款，从而减少净美元敞口，并产生正相关关系。

title: Does Chinese foreign aid enhance state capacity in recipient countries?
title_zh: 中国对外援助是否增强了受援国的国家能力？
title_primary: 中国对外援助是否增强了受援国的国家能力？
title_secondary: Does Chinese foreign aid enhance state capacity in recipient countries?
authors: Yunbo Zhou, Sixiao Ren, Jialei Sheng, Chao Lei, Jinxing Guo
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-17 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper examines whether Chinese foreign aid strengthens state capacity in recipient countries. We construct a country-year panel covering 214 countries over 2000–2021 by combining AidData’s Global Chinese Development Finance Dataset with a latent-variable measure of state capacity. To address aid allocation endogeneity, we instrument Chinese official development assistance (ODA) using the interaction between China’s steel production and each recipient’s historical propensity to receive Chinese aid. The results show that one additional Chinese ODA project increases the state-capacity index by 0.032 points, equivalent to 9.22% of the sample mean. This finding remains robust to controlling for additional recipient characteristics, other aid sources, policy factors, and spatial spillovers. The effect is stronger in countries that are institutionally or politically closer to China and for aid directed towards production and infrastructure sectors, with infrastructure provision and bilateral economic engagement serving as the primary channels. The estimates for official finance (OF) and other official financing (OOF) remain positive but are smaller and less precisely estimated, highlighting the distinctive role of concessional ODA in state capacity building. From a policy perspective, this finding suggests that concessional aid can strengthen recipient governments’ capacity to implement policies and pursue self-reliant development. abstract_zh: 本文考察了中国对外援助是否增强了受援国的国家能力。通过结合AidData的全球中国发展融资数据集与国家能力的潜变量测度，我们构建了一个覆盖2000年至2021年214个国家的国家-年份面板数据。为处理援助分配的内生性问题，我们利用中国钢铁产量与各受援国历史上接受中国援助的倾向之间的交互项，作为中国官方发展援助（ODA）的工具变量。结果显示，每增加一个中国ODA项目，国家能力指数提升0.032点，相当于样本均值的9.22%。在控制额外受援国特征、其他援助来源、政策因素及空间溢出效应后，这一发现依然稳健。该效应在制度或政治上与中国更接近的国家中更为显著，且对投向生产与基础设施部门的援助效果更强，其中基础设施供给与双边经济交往是主要作用渠道。官方融资（OF）及其他官方融资（OOF）的估计系数虽为正，但数值较小且显著性较弱，凸显了优惠性ODA在国家能力建设中的独特作用。从政策角度看，这一发现表明，优惠性援助能够增强受援国政府实施政策及追求自主发展的能力。关键词：中国援助 ODA 国家能力 基础设施项目 JEL分类：F35：对外援助 O19：国际组织在发展中的国际联系作用 P45：国际贸易、金融、投资与援助 O43：制度与增长 H11：政府的结构、范围与绩效

title: Credence Goods, Consumer Feedback and (in)Efficiency
title_zh: 信任品、消费者反馈与（非）效率
title_primary: 信任品、消费者反馈与（非）效率
title_secondary: Credence Goods, Consumer Feedback and (in)Efficiency
authors: Mehdi Ayouni, Thomas Lanzi
official: 官方在线 2026-08-11 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study how consumer feedback affects a credence good market where consumers sequentially visit a monopolistic expert. Each consumer's problem can be minor or major. Before treatment, the expert performs a diagnosis which may fail. Each consumer reveals the received treatment and its outcome. Consumers observe feedback history and decide whether to visit the expert. We find that consumer feedback can lead to inefficiency. When diagnosis fails, the expert overtreats consumers even though the probability of a major problem is low. This behavior does not arise without consumer feedback.
abstract_zh: 我们研究消费者反馈如何影响一个信任品市场，在该市场中，消费者依次访问垄断专家。每位消费者的问题可能是轻微的或严重的。在治疗前，专家进行诊断，但诊断可能失败。每位消费者会透露所接受的治疗及其结果。消费者观察反馈历史并决定是否访问专家。我们发现，消费者反馈可能导致效率低下。当诊断失败时，即使严重问题的概率较低，专家也会过度治疗消费者。这种行为在没有消费者反馈的情况下不会出现。

title: Perhaps Still the Lesser Evil? The Trouble Investigating Glyphosate Health Effects in the US
title_zh: 或许仍是较轻之恶？美国草甘膦健康效应调查之困境
title_primary: 或许仍是较轻之恶？美国草甘膦健康效应调查之困境
title_secondary: Perhaps Still the Lesser Evil? The Trouble Investigating Glyphosate Health Effects in the US
authors: Ferraro, Greg, Brown, Zachary, Moschini, Giancarlo, Perry, Ed
official: 官方在线 2026-08-10 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Glyphosate, the active ingredient of the herbicide RoundUp, has been subject to extensive scrutiny since the introduction of genetically engineered glyphosate tolerant crops in 1995. However, both a lack of observational studies and continued uncertainty around the toxicity of glyphosate emissions contribute to international political controversy and numerous civil actions at a time when US rural health measures are worsening and youth cancer rates are rising. Recent quasi-experimental studies using genetically engineered crop adoption as a source of exposure variation found glyphosate applications caused deleterious infant health effects in rural US areas, but we are unsure their exposure is truly exogenous. We reassess glyphosate’s effects on infant health using two sources of exposure variation in two-stage least squares instrumental variable approaches for twelve different infant health measures. We first similarly employ genetically engineered crop adoption but using seed sale marketing data, which is a more accurate measure of adoption relative to previous attempts. We then use changes in glyphosate product characteristics from the introduction of generic product types using product sales marking data, which is a novel separate source of variation. We do not find any consistent significant health changes from glyphosate exposure, where estimates are generally precise, pass typical assumption tests, and are robust to alternative specifications. By investigating the association between genetically engineered crop adoption and several rural co-occurring health and agricultural trends, we obtain evidence exposure variation from genetically engineered crop adoption is probably not independent from other agricultural production externalities. While this study provides evidence glyphosate did not contribute to rural health problems from 1995 to 2013, we believe pesticide data limitations, continued glyphosate controversy, and remaining potential for toxic agricultural emissions justifies evaluations of improved environmental monitoring.
abstract_zh: 草甘膦，作为除草剂RoundUp的活性成分，自1995年转基因耐草甘膦作物引入以来，一直受到广泛关注。然而，观察性研究的缺乏以及草甘膦排放毒性方面的持续不确定性，在美国农村健康指标恶化、青少年癌症发病率上升之际，引发了国际政治争议和大量民事诉讼。近期利用转基因作物采用作为暴露变异来源的准实验研究发现，草甘膦施用对美国农村地区婴儿健康产生了不良影响，但我们不确定其暴露是否真正外生。我们重新评估草甘膦对婴儿健康的影响，采用两种暴露变异来源，通过两阶段最小二乘工具变量方法，针对十二项不同的婴儿健康指标进行分析。首先，我们同样利用转基因作物的采用情况，但使用种子销售市场数据，这比以往尝试更能准确衡量采用程度。其次，我们利用产品市场销售数据，通过引入非专利产品类型导致的草甘膦产品特性变化，这是一个新颖且独立的变异来源。我们未发现草甘膦暴露导致任何一致且显著的健康变化，估计结果普遍精确，通过常规假设检验，并对不同规格设定具有稳健性。通过探究转基因作物采用与农村地区同时发生的健康及农业趋势之间的关联，我们获得证据表明，转基因作物采用带来的暴露变异可能并非独立于其他农业生产外部性。尽管本研究提供了1995年至2013年间草甘膦未导致农村健康问题的证据，但我们认为，农药数据局限性、持续的草甘膦争议以及有毒农业排放的潜在风险，都要求对改进环境监测进行评估。

title: Fortunate Sons: Elite Political Selection in American History
title_zh: 幸运之子：美国历史上的精英政治选拔
title_primary: 幸运之子：美国历史上的精英政治选拔
title_secondary: Fortunate Sons: Elite Political Selection in American History
authors: James J. Feigenbaum, Andrew B. Hall, Daniel M. Thompson, Jesse Yoder
official: 官方在线 2026-08-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We trace the family origins of Members of Congress (MC) born between 1830 and 1950, linking each MC, their parents, and their brothers to the complete-count censuses. Future MCs have always been economic outliers. By 1940, close to 60 percent of MCs aged 18--40 held a college degree, against under 5 percent of comparable young men outside Congress. In the 19th-century censuses, MCs as adults held roughly three times the wealth of demographically matched controls. They also come from economically elite families: their fathers earn more, attain more education, and hold more wealth. The brothers of future MCs sit between the population and the MCs themselves. Across the socioeconomic measures we compare, we calculate that roughly half of an MC's adult premium is shared with his brother and the other half is his own. Even as the American economy and political system have changed, the family background gap has widened over the last century and a half. Wealth, household servants, and four separate occupation-based scores all show the gap holding or growing across cohorts. We study four Progressive-Era reforms in a triple-difference design---women's suffrage, the secret ballot, direct primaries, and the direct election of senators---and none produce detectable shifts in who reaches Congress. Our results document a Congress drawn from the most fortunate families in American society in every cohort we observe.
abstract_zh: 我们追溯了1830年至1950年间出生的国会议员（MC）的家庭出身，将每位议员、其父母及兄弟与完整人口普查数据相链接。未来的国会议员历来都是经济上的异类。到1940年，18至40岁的国会议员中近60%拥有大学学位，而国会外同龄年轻男性中这一比例不足5%。在19世纪的人口普查中，作为成年人的国会议员所拥有的财富约为人口统计特征匹配对照组的三倍。他们也出身于经济精英家庭：其父亲收入更高、受教育程度更高、财富更多。未来国会议员的兄弟们则介于普通民众与议员本人之间。在我们比较的各项社会经济指标中，我们估算出议员成年期优势中约有一半与其兄弟共享，另一半则为其个人独有。即便美国经济和政治体制不断变迁，家庭背景差距在过去一个半世纪中仍在扩大。财富、家中仆役数量以及四种基于职业的评分均显示，这一差距在各代际间保持或扩大。我们采用三重差分设计研究了进步时代四项改革——妇女选举权、无记名投票、直接初选和参议员直接选举——均未对进入国会的人员构成产生可检测的变化。我们的研究结果表明，在我们观察的每一代人中，国会成员均来自美国社会中最幸运的家庭。

title: Early socio-emotional skills and adolescent offending: evidence from administrative data
title_zh: 早期社会情感技能与青少年犯罪：来自行政数据的证据
title_primary: 早期社会情感技能与青少年犯罪：来自行政数据的证据
title_secondary: Early socio-emotional skills and adolescent offending: evidence from administrative data
authors: Garcia, Paul
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper examines how early socio-emotional skills shape adolescent offending in England and the school pathways through which they operate. I use administrative data linking teacher-reported child development assessments at age five to school and criminal justice records through age 17. Factor analysis of these assessments reveals two underlying domains of early difficulty, cognitive and socio-emotional. Both raise the probability of a caution or conviction between ages 11 and 17 by around 15%, but through distinct channels. Cognitive difficulties act primarily through academic attainment, while socio-emotional difficulties operate largely through school exclusions yet retain a substantial direct effect, accounting for around 40% of the total effect. The socio-emotional effect is robust to unobserved school and family heterogeneity and shapes both the type and frequency of offending. Statutory support for learning difficulties and social care services attenuates the associations between early skill deficits and offending. These findings suggest that differentiated support is needed based on the type of difficulty.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了早期社会情感技能如何塑造英格兰青少年的犯罪行为及其通过学校路径发挥作用的机制。我利用行政数据，将五岁时教师评估的儿童发展结果与至17岁的学校及刑事司法记录相链接。对这些评估的因子分析揭示了早期困难的两个潜在领域：认知与社会情感。两者均使11至17岁期间受到警告或定罪的概率提高约15%，但通过不同的渠道发挥作用。认知困难主要通过学业成就起作用，而社会情感困难则主要通过学校排斥产生影响，但仍保留显著的直接效应，约占总效应的40%。社会情感效应在考虑未观测到的学校与家庭异质性后依然稳健，并影响犯罪类型及频率。针对学习困难和社会关怀服务的法定支持减弱了早期技能缺陷与犯罪行为之间的关联。这些发现表明，根据困难类型需要提供差异化的支持。

title: Integrating Threatened Biodiversity in Monetary Ecosystem Accounting: Choice Experiments and Simulated Exchange Values
title_zh: 将受威胁生物多样性纳入货币化生态系统核算：选择实验与模拟交换价值
title_primary: 将受威胁生物多样性纳入货币化生态系统核算：选择实验与模拟交换价值
title_secondary: Integrating Threatened Biodiversity in Monetary Ecosystem Accounting: Choice Experiments and Simulated Exchange Values
authors: Jose L. Oviedo, Pablo Campos, Alejandro Caparrós, Gonzalo M. Arroyo, Andrés De La Cruz
official: 官方在线 2026-07-23 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We present a valuation framework for measuring the non-market net operating surplus associated with threatened wild species preservation for monetary ecosystem accounting . We use the Simulated Exchange Value ( SEV ) method, which estimates the maximum benefit that could be internalized in a hypothetical market using the demand simulated from a choice experiment, a given market supply, and an assumed market structure. The choice experiment estimates willingness to pay (WTP), in addition to current tax-funded costs, for achieving different stock levels of wild species across threat categories defined by the International Union for Conservation of Nature Red List. We apply this framework to the valuation of threatened waterbird species preservation in the coastal wetlands of the southwestern Iberian Peninsula. The results show that WTP increases as the number of threatened species decreases, with the critically endangered species generating the highest WTP and no statistically significant differences between vulnerable and endangered species. Based on our preferred model, we estimate a SEV of the net operating surplus of €2,850 per hectare per year for the current stock levels of threatened waterbird species. The equivalent variation estimated for the same stock level is €4,108 per hectare per year.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种估值框架，用于衡量与受威胁野生物种保护相关的非市场净经营盈余，以服务于货币化生态系统核算。我们采用模拟交换价值（SEV）方法，该方法通过选择实验模拟的需求、给定的市场供给以及假定的市场结构，估算在假设市场中可内部化的最大收益。该选择实验估算了除当前税收资助成本之外，为实现国际自然保护联盟（IUCN）红色名录所定义的不同威胁类别野生物种存量水平而支付的意愿（WTP）。我们将此框架应用于伊比利亚半岛西南部沿海湿地受威胁水鸟物种保护的估值。结果显示，随着受威胁物种数量的减少，WTP增加，其中极危物种产生的WTP最高，而易危物种与濒危物种之间无统计学显著差异。基于我们的优选模型，我们估算出当前受威胁水鸟物种存量水平的净经营盈余SEV为每公顷每年2850欧元。同一存量水平下估算的等价变差为每公顷每年4108欧元。

title: Bank Runs With and Without Bank Failure
title_zh: 银行挤兑与银行倒闭：有与无
title_primary: 银行挤兑与银行倒闭：有与无
title_secondary: Bank Runs With and Without Bank Failure
authors: Sergio A. Correia, Stephan Luck, Emil Verner
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study the causes and consequences of bank runs. By applying large language models to historical newspapers, we create a comprehensive database of bank runs in U.S. history with information on 3,984 runs on individual banks from 1863 to 1934. Our novel data allow us to establish that runs are considerably more likely in weak banks but also occur in strong banks, especially in response to negative news about the real economy or the broader banking system. However, runs typically only result in failure for banks with poor fundamentals. Strong banks survive runs through various mechanisms, including signaling strength, interbank cooperation, and temporary suspension. At the local level, runs on banks with poor fundamentals translate into substantially larger declines in deposits, lending, and manufacturing activity than runs on strong banks. Our findings imply that poor fundamentals are central to explaining both when runs occur and when they have severe economic effects, tempering the view that small shocks can generate discontinuous jumps to bad equilibria through self-fulfilling run dynamics.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了银行挤兑的成因与后果。通过将大语言模型应用于历史报纸，我们构建了一个涵盖美国历史上银行挤兑事件的综合数据库，包含1863年至1934年间3984次针对单个银行的挤兑信息。这一全新数据使我们得以证实：挤兑更可能发生在弱势银行，但也会发生在强势银行，尤其是当实体经济或整个银行体系出现负面消息时。然而，挤兑通常仅导致基本面较差的银行倒闭。强势银行则通过多种机制存活，包括释放实力信号、银行间合作以及临时暂停营业。在地方层面，基本面较差的银行遭遇挤兑后，其存款、贷款和制造业活动的下降幅度显著大于强势银行遭遇挤兑的情况。我们的研究结果表明，基本面薄弱是解释挤兑何时发生以及何时产生严重经济影响的核心因素，这削弱了“小冲击可通过自我实现的挤兑动态引发向不良均衡的非连续跳跃”这一观点。

authors: Bertrand, Marianne, Crépon, Bruno, Marguerie, Alicia, Premand, Patrick

abstract: We study contemporaneous and post-program impacts of a public works program, which provides urban youth seven months of employment at the formal minimum wage with complementary training on entrepreneurship or job search. During the program, we find limited impacts on employment, but a shift toward wage jobs, higher earnings and savings, as well as positive changes in work habits, behaviors, and well-being. After the program, we find no lasting impact on employment or behaviors, with only limited gains in earnings stemming from independent activities. Using machine learning to analyze heterogeneity, we show that alternative targeting approaches can substantially improve welfare.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一项公共工程项目在实施期间及结束后的影响。该项目为城市青年提供为期七个月的正式最低工资就业，并辅以创业或求职培训。在项目实施期间，我们发现其对就业的影响有限，但促使就业向工资性工作转移，提高了收入和储蓄，并在工作习惯、行为及福祉方面产生了积极变化。项目结束后，就业或行为方面未发现持久影响，仅从独立活动中获得有限的收入增长。通过机器学习分析异质性，我们表明替代性的目标定位方法可以显著改善福利。

abstract: A profit-maximizing monopolist curates a database for users seek- ing to learn a parameter. There are two user types: "Nowcasters" wish to learn the parameter's current value, while "forecasters" target its long-run value. Data storage involves a constant marginal cost. The monopolist designs a menu of contracts described by fees and data-access levels. The profit-maximizing menu o¤ers full access to historical data, while current data is fully provided to nowcasters but may be withheld from forecasters. Compared to the social optimum, the monopolist keeps too much historical data, too little current data, and may store too much data overall.
abstract_zh: 一个追求利润最大化的垄断者为试图学习某个参数的用户构建数据库。用户分为两类："即时预测者"希望了解该参数的当前值，而"长期预测者"则关注其长期值。数据存储涉及恒定的边际成本。垄断者设计了一套由费用和数据访问权限组成的合同菜单。利润最大化的菜单提供对历史数据的完全访问，同时当前数据被完全提供给即时预测者，但可能对长期预测者有所保留。与社会最优相比，垄断者保留了过多的历史数据、过少的当前数据，并且整体上可能存储了过多的数据。

official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Misaligned incentives within organizations may explain why firms fail to adopt or fully benefit from productive technologies. We conducted a randomized controlled trial in Indian garment factories in which units received an anonymous worker-management communication technology, this technology paired with incentives for HR managers to communicate effectively with workers, or neither (control). We find that the technology alone had no impacts relative to control. But pairing the technology with HR incentives increased productivity by 5%, reduced absenteeism by 13%, and raised worker earnings by 3%. Impacts were driven by greater HR responsiveness and increased worker reporting of production-related issues.
abstract_zh: 组织内部的激励错位可能解释了企业为何未能采纳或充分受益于高效技术。我们在印度服装工厂开展了一项随机对照试验，其中部分工厂获得匿名员工-管理层沟通技术，部分工厂在技术基础上附加对人力资源经理有效沟通的激励措施，其余工厂则未获得任何干预（对照组）。研究发现，仅提供技术本身相较于对照组未产生显著影响。但将技术与人力资源激励相结合后，生产率提升5%，缺勤率降低13%，工人收入增加3%。这些影响源于人力资源响应度的提高以及工人对生产相关问题报告频率的增加。

title: What's the worth of a promise? Evaluating the long‐term effects of a programme to reduce early marriage in India

authors: Shreya Biswas, Upasak Das
official: 官方在线 2026-06-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines the long-term effects of ‘Apni Beti Apna Dhan’ (ABAD), a unique conditional cash transfer programme implemented in the north Indian state of Haryana from 1994 to 1998. The programme provided bonds to female beneficiaries at birth, redeemable on attaining 18 years of age, if they remained unmarried. In particular, we examine the programme effects on prevalence of early marriage and then on educational attainment. Exploiting the exogenous variation in the birth year of females born when the programme was implemented, we find a significant reduction in the likelihood of early marriage before age 18 among ABAD beneficiaries. Additionally, the prevalence of marriage by age 16, 17 or 18 is found to reduce, though the likelihood of being married by age 19 remains unchanged. We further observe robust improvements in their educational attainment. Despite reduction in early marriage and years of education, we do not find any discernible evidence of improvements in labour market participation, time allocation patterns, women empowerment indicators or intergenerational spillover. We provide suggestive evidence of parents utilizing the educational gains to ensure marital association with families of higher social status.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了“Apni Beti Apna Dhan”（ABAD）这一独特的有条件现金转移项目的长期效应，该项目于1994年至1998年在印度北部哈里亚纳邦实施。该项目为女性受益人在出生时提供债券，若她们在年满18岁时保持未婚，则可兑现。我们特别关注该项目对早婚普遍性及其后教育成就的影响。利用项目实施期间出生女性出生年份的外生变异，我们发现ABAD受益人在18岁前早婚的可能性显著降低。此外，16岁、17岁或18岁时的结婚率也有所下降，但19岁时的结婚可能性未发生变化。我们还观察到她们教育成就的显著提升。尽管早婚减少且受教育年限增加，我们未发现劳动市场参与、时间分配模式、女性赋权指标或代际溢出效应有任何明显改善的证据。我们提供了暗示性证据，表明父母利用教育收益来确保与更高社会地位家庭的婚姻联系。

title: Interactions of behavioral interventions across pro-environmental domains: A natural field experiment
title_zh: 跨环保行为领域的行为干预互动：一项自然田野实验
title_primary: 跨环保行为领域的行为干预互动：一项自然田野实验
title_secondary: Interactions of behavioral interventions across pro-environmental domains: A natural field experiment
authors: Maoliang Ling, Yiming Liu, Lin Xu, Juntao He
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Despite the proliferation of behavioral nudges across pro-environmental domains, it remains unclear whether and how these interventions interact. We study nudge interactions through a two-year natural field experiment, in which two Home Report-type social-comparison interventions—targeting household waste sorting (HWSR) and water conservation (HWR), respectively—were implemented either independently or jointly. The HWSR improved waste sorting regardless of whether the HWR was also applied. However, while the HWR reduced water consumption when implemented alone, it became ineffective when combined with the HWSR. This crowding-out effect eliminates the welfare gains from the HWR under pre-existing water tariffs that weakly internalize the environmental costs of water use. Additional evidence suggests that crowding out was most pronounced in communities with high social capital and without monetary rewards for waste sorting, and that the HWSR strengthened recipients’ moral-normative beliefs in these communities. We discuss potential crowding-out mechanisms related to attention and preferences.
abstract_zh: 尽管行为助推在环保领域日益普及，但这些干预措施之间是否以及如何相互作用仍不明确。我们通过一项为期两年的自然实地实验研究助推互动，其中两类基于家庭报告型的社会比较干预——分别针对家庭垃圾分类（HWSR）和节水（HWR）——被独立或联合实施。HWSR在无论是否同时实施HWR的情况下均改善了垃圾分类。然而，HWR在单独实施时减少了用水量，但与HWSR联合实施时则失效。这种挤出效应消除了在现有水价弱化水资源使用环境成本的情况下HWR带来的福利收益。额外证据表明，挤出效应在社会资本高且无垃圾分类货币奖励的社区中最为显著，且HWSR在这些社区中强化了接受者的道德规范性信念。我们讨论了与注意力和偏好相关的潜在挤出机制。

title: Bureaucratic norms and dynamic Bayesian persuasion
title_zh: 官僚规范与动态贝叶斯说服
title_primary: 官僚规范与动态贝叶斯说服
title_secondary: Bureaucratic norms and dynamic Bayesian persuasion
authors: Yihang Zhou
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-30 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: A developer seeks to persuade a sequence of two short-tenured officials to award her a contract. Officials maximize social welfare, and the second official follows a bureaucratic norm requiring reliance only on evidence presented directly to him. Thus, Bayesian inference is restricted when the first official defers the decision, because the second does not observe the first official’s evidence. The first official can exploit this restriction to induce more informative experiments. When the static value of persuasion is zero for the bureaucracy but positive for the developer, two outcomes arise: either the first official decides immediately with more information, increasing social welfare, or delay occurs, with delay costs offsetting informational benefits. In both cases, the developer’s expected payoff is lower than under static persuasion. With unrestricted inference, an intuitive PBE replicates the static outcome, so the norm may increase social welfare and never reduces it relative to the static benchmark.
abstract_zh: 一位开发商试图说服两位任期短暂、相继上任的官员授予其合同。官员们追求社会福利最大化，而第二位官员遵循官僚规范，仅依赖直接呈递给他的证据。因此，当第一位官员推迟决策时，贝叶斯推断受到限制，因为第二位官员无法观察到第一位官员的证据。第一位官员可以利用这一限制来诱导更具信息量的实验。当说服的静态价值对官僚机构为零但对开发商为正时，会出现两种结果：要么第一位官员立即决策并掌握更多信息，从而增加社会福利；要么发生延迟，延迟成本抵消信息收益。在两种情况下，开发商的预期收益均低于静态说服下的水平。在无限制推断下，一个直观的完美贝叶斯均衡复制了静态结果，因此该规范可能增加社会福利，且相对于静态基准而言，绝不会降低社会福利。

title: Environmental Information or Social Norm? A Ladder Toward Environmentally Sustainable Food Choices
title_zh: 环境信息还是社会规范？迈向环境可持续食品选择的阶梯
title_primary: 环境信息还是社会规范？迈向环境可持续食品选择的阶梯
title_secondary: Environmental Information or Social Norm? A Ladder Toward Environmentally Sustainable Food Choices
authors: Ryosuke Inoue, Kentaro Kawasaki
official: 官方在线 2026-05-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: ABSTRACT Agricultural production and the food supply chain have a significant impact on the environment. To foster an environmentally sustainable food system, it is vital to change consumers' food choice patterns to be more environmentally sustainable. This study presents a concept ladder , a simplified model under which consumers may be at different stages in terms of their willingness and ability to make environmentally sustainable food choices: some may have little concern, others may have more concern but require the impetus of broader social norms to modify their choices, while a final group may have strong concern but in some cases be unable to exercise their preferences because of financial or other constraints. To empirically test this concept, we conducted a large‐scale randomised experiment involving Japanese consumers through two online surveys. In the first survey, respondents were randomly separated into three groups and provided with either environmental issue information (T1), social norm information (T2) or no information (Control). Two weeks later, a follow‐up survey was conducted to compare the actual environmental sustainability of food choice behaviours among the groups. The results show that the treatment effect of T1 is the largest for those with a low level of environmental concern, while the treatment effect of T2 is the largest for those with a moderate level of environmental concern, consistent with the ladder concept. Several robustness checks support these findings.
abstract_zh: 摘要 农业生产及食品供应链对环境具有显著影响。为构建环境可持续的食品体系，转变消费者的食品选择模式以更加环境友好至关重要。本研究提出“概念阶梯”这一简化模型，在该模型下，消费者在做出环境可持续食品选择的意愿和能力方面可能处于不同阶段：部分消费者可能关注度较低，另一些则可能关注度较高但需借助更广泛社会规范的推动来调整其选择，而最后一类消费者可能具有强烈关注，但在某些情况下因财务或其他限制而无法践行其偏好。为实证检验这一概念，我们通过两项在线调查对日本消费者进行了大规模随机实验。在第一项调查中，受访者被随机分为三组，分别接收环境问题信息（T1）、社会规范信息（T2）或未接收任何信息（对照组）。两周后，进行后续调查以比较各组食品选择行为的实际环境可持续性。结果显示，T1的处理效应在环境关注度较低的群体中最大，而T2的处理效应在环境关注度中等的群体中最大，这与阶梯概念相符。多项稳健性检验支持了这些发现。

title: Environmental Performance Evaluation Under the Frontier Analysis Framework: A Farm‐Level Systematic Review and Meta‐Analysis
title_zh: 前沿分析框架下的环境绩效评估：农场层面的系统综述与元分析
title_primary: 前沿分析框架下的环境绩效评估：农场层面的系统综述与元分析
title_secondary: Environmental Performance Evaluation Under the Frontier Analysis Framework: A Farm‐Level Systematic Review and Meta‐Analysis
authors: Fissha Asmare, Bethan Thompson, Tarek Soliman, Thomas Donovan, Klaus Glenk 等
official: 官方在线 2026-05-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: ABSTRACT Quantifying and improving the environmental performance (EP) of agriculture has become an urgent research and policy priority. Over the past three decades, frontier‐based analytical frameworks have been widely applied to evaluate farm‐level EP. We present a global systematic review and meta‐analysis of 121 studies (comprising 800 unique environmental performance estimates) that use a frontier‐based approach for farm‐level EP evaluation. Adhering to PRISMA guidelines, we extract and synthesise information on modelling approaches, estimation methods, pollutant types, as well as other data and study characteristics. We also consider the determinants for EP. We find that there is inertia in the shift towards more recent and methodologically better environmental performance evaluation techniques, such as the by‐production approach and material balance methods, at the farm level. A random effects meta‐regression reveals that the methodological approach and estimation methods explain the variation in EP. Farm type and inclusion of determinants are also important. We identify multiple significant determinants of environmental performance across agricultural systems. The findings advance academic understanding of how modelling frameworks shape EP estimates. They also offer practical insights to help policymakers understand specific policy variables and farm‐specific factors that could be leveraged to improve environmental performance. For example, fostering pro‐environmental attitudes and encouraging the adoption of sustainable agricultural practices through extension services can help enhance environmental performance in farming.
abstract_zh: 摘要 量化并提升农业环境绩效已成为当前研究与政策制定的迫切议题。过去三十年间，基于前沿的分析框架被广泛用于评估农场层面的环境绩效。我们开展了一项全球系统性回顾与元分析，涵盖121项研究（包含800个独特的环境绩效估计值），这些研究均采用前沿方法评估农场环境绩效。遵循PRISMA指南，我们提取并综合了建模方法、估计技术、污染物类型以及其他数据与研究特征的信息，同时探讨了环境绩效的决定因素。研究发现，在农场层面，向更新且方法论上更优的环境绩效评估技术（如副产物法和物质平衡法）的转变存在惯性。随机效应元回归分析显示，方法论途径和估计方法解释了环境绩效的变异，农场类型及决定因素的纳入同样重要。我们识别出多个影响农业系统环境绩效的关键决定因素。这些发现深化了学术界对建模框架如何塑造环境绩效估计的理解，并为政策制定者提供了实用见解，帮助他们识别可通过特定政策变量和农场特定因素来提升环境绩效的途径。例如，通过推广服务培养亲环境态度并鼓励采纳可持续农业实践，有助于增强农业环境绩效。

title: Sustainable Livestock Decisions in a Post‐Conflict Frontier: Evidence From Colombia's Orinoquía
title_zh: 后冲突前沿地区的可持续畜牧业决策：来自哥伦比亚奥里诺基亚地区的证据
title_primary: 后冲突前沿地区的可持续畜牧业决策：来自哥伦比亚奥里诺基亚地区的证据
title_secondary: Sustainable Livestock Decisions in a Post‐Conflict Frontier: Evidence From Colombia's Orinoquía
authors: Hernando Flórez‐Díaz, Emiliano Lopez Barrera, Adriana María Molina‐Romero, Diana Elisa Correa‐Pinilla, Carlos Fontanilla‐Díaz
official: 官方在线 2026-05-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The Orinoquía region is one of Colombia's principal agricultural frontiers and has been shaped by long‐standing armed‐conflict dynamics that continue to influence land governance, producer incentives, and investment decisions. Efforts to promote sustainable cattle production emphasize two key practices: sustainable pasture management (including rotational grazing systems) and ecologically appropriate stocking rates. However, their adoption varies widely because of institutional, economic, and biophysical constraints. This study applies a dual binary choice framework to examine the adoption decisions associated with these two practices and to assess whether they operate sequentially or independently. Results show that tenure security, measured through formal landownership, is strongly associated with the adoption of sustainable pasture management. In contrast, access to technical assistance is negatively associated with adoption, suggesting issues of program quality, targeting, or reverse causality. Older and more experienced producers are less likely to adopt, indicating path dependence. For stocking‐rate decisions, rotational and alternating grazing systems exhibit lower probabilities of meeting sustainable thresholds, likely reflecting implementation challenges in extensive systems. Larger finishing areas also tend to be managed less sustainably, and descriptive evidence suggests that unsustainable stocking in our sample is more frequently associated with understocking than overstocking, with 239 producers (70%) below 1 animal per hectare. These findings illustrate how structural and institutional conditions, including those linked to conflict legacies, shape sustainability transitions in the Orinoquía and can inform more tailored policy interventions for frontier livestock regions.
abstract_zh: 奥里诺基亚地区是哥伦比亚主要的农业边疆之一，长期武装冲突动态持续影响着土地治理、生产者激励和投资决策。推动可持续畜牧业发展的努力聚焦于两项关键实践：可持续牧场管理（包括轮牧系统）和生态适宜载畜率。然而，由于制度、经济和生物物理条件的制约，这些实践的采纳程度差异显著。本研究采用二元选择框架，分析这两项实践的采纳决策，并评估其是顺序推进还是独立进行。结果表明，通过正式土地所有权衡量的产权保障与可持续牧场管理的采纳密切相关。相反，技术援助的获取与采纳呈负相关，暗示项目质量、目标定位或反向因果问题。年龄较大、经验更丰富的生产者采纳意愿较低，体现了路径依赖效应。在载畜率决策中，轮牧和交替放牧系统达到可持续阈值的概率较低，这反映了粗放型系统中的实施挑战。较大的育肥区域往往管理更不可持续，描述性证据表明，样本中不可持续载畜更常表现为载畜不足而非过度载畜，239名生产者（70%）的载畜率低于每公顷1头。这些发现揭示了结构性及制度条件（包括与冲突遗留问题相关的条件）如何塑造奥里诺基亚地区的可持续转型，并为针对边疆畜牧区域制定更精准的政策干预提供依据。

title: An Empirical Model of Quantity Discounts with Large Choice Sets
title_zh: 大选择集下数量折扣的实证模型
title_primary: 大选择集下数量折扣的实证模型
title_secondary: An Empirical Model of Quantity Discounts with Large Choice Sets
authors: Alessandro Iaria, Ao Wang
source: Journal of the European Economic Association
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-23 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We introduce a Generalized Nested Logit model of demand for bundles that can be estimated sequentially, eliminating the challenge of dimensionality due to large choice sets. We use it to investigate quantity discounts for carbonated soft drinks by simulating a counterfactual with linear pricing. The prices of small-volume UPCs (<2L) decrease by −29.2% while those of large-volume UPCs (≥2L) increase by +16.8%. Purchased quantities decrease by −19.5% and industry profit by −6.3%. Consumer surplus however reduces only moderately, suggesting that a ban on quantity discounts on sugary drinks may be a simple and effective policy to limit added sugar intake. Our calculations confirm that such a ban would be as effective as a sugar tax of 1.5/oz of added sugar and reduce added sugar intake by −17.4%. A nested logit model that mistakenly ignores joint purchases of UPCs within shopping trips would instead simulate a reduction in added sugar intake of only −3.9%.
abstract_zh: 本文提出一种广义嵌套Logit需求模型，用于估计捆绑商品的需求，该模型可通过序贯估计方法解决因选择集过大带来的维度问题。我们利用该模型研究碳酸饮料的数量折扣问题，通过模拟线性定价的反事实情景发现：小容量UPC（<2升）价格下降29.2%，而大容量UPC（≥2升）价格上涨16.8%。购买量减少19.5%，行业利润下降6.3%，但消费者剩余仅温和下降，这表明禁止含糖饮料的数量折扣可能是限制添加糖摄入的简单有效政策。我们的计算证实，该禁令的效果相当于对每盎司添加糖征收1.5美分的糖税，可使添加糖摄入量减少17.4%。若错误采用忽略购物行程中UPC联合购买的嵌套Logit模型，则模拟得出的添加糖摄入量降幅仅为3.9%。

title: Ballots, budgets and bricks: Brexit and the polarisation of individual economic behaviours
title_zh: 选票、预算与砖块：英国脱欧与个体经济行为的极化
title_primary: 选票、预算与砖块：英国脱欧与个体经济行为的极化
title_secondary: Ballots, budgets and bricks: Brexit and the polarisation of individual economic behaviours
authors: Pei Kuang, Davide Luca, Zhiwu Wei
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-22 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Does political polarisation influence actual economic behaviours? Using British nationally representative surveys and administrative data, we document how the Brexit referendum triggered stark divergences in individual micro and macro expectations between Leave and Remain supporters. Compared to existing research, we show how these polarising effects were driven by a specific policy issue and mostly unrelated to traditional partisan identities. We also demonstrate howthese diverging beliefs influenced major real financial decisions. Leavers became more likely to purchase durable goods and engage in housing transactions, and areas with higher proportions of Leave voters experienced increased housing transaction volumes and rising prices.
abstract_zh: 政治极化是否会影响实际经济行为？利用英国全国代表性调查与行政数据，我们记录了脱欧公投如何引发脱欧派与留欧派在个人微观及宏观预期上的显著分歧。与现有研究相比，我们揭示了这些极化效应是由特定政策议题驱动，且与传统党派身份关联不大。我们还证明了这些分歧信念如何影响重大实际财务决策。脱欧派更倾向于购买耐用消费品并参与住房交易，而脱欧选民比例较高的地区则经历了住房交易量增加和价格上涨。

title: Buyer Power and the Effect of Vertical Integration on Innovation
title_zh: 买方势力与纵向一体化对创新的影响
title_primary: 买方势力与纵向一体化对创新的影响
title_secondary: Buyer Power and the Effect of Vertical Integration on Innovation
authors: Claire Chambolle, Morgane Guignard
official: 官方在线 2026-04-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Our article investigates the impact of vertical integration (without foreclosure) on innovation. We compare cases where either (i) two manufacturers or (ii) a manufacturer and a vertically integrated retailer invest. Then, the independent manufacturer(s) and the retailer bargain over nonlinear contracts before selling to consumers. We show that vertical integration always increases the incentives to invest in the integrated product, which stifles (resp. spurs) the investment of the independent manufacturer when spillovers are low (resp. high). In contrast, when investments are sequential, if the buyer power is high, and the independent manufacturer chooses its investment first, it invests more (resp. less) to discourage the integrated retailer's investment when spillovers are low (resp. high). Furthermore, vertical integration is always profitable even when it is not desirable for the industry and welfare. Overall, vertical integration is desirable for the industry when the buyer power is high, and may harm welfare when both the buyer power and spillovers are low.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了纵向一体化（不含排他性行为）对创新的影响。我们比较了两种情形：一是两家制造商分别投资，二是制造商与纵向一体化零售商共同投资。随后，独立制造商与零售商在向消费者销售前就非线性合同进行谈判。研究表明，纵向一体化总是提升一体化产品的投资激励，在溢出效应低（高）时，这会抑制（促进）独立制造商的投资。相反，在投资顺序进行的情况下，若买方势力较强，且独立制造商先行选择投资，则其在溢出效应低（高）时会增加（减少）投资以抑制一体化零售商的后续投资。此外，纵向一体化始终具有盈利性，即便在行业整体及社会福利角度并非最优时亦然。总体而言，当买方势力较强时，纵向一体化对行业有利；而当买方势力与溢出效应均较低时，可能损害社会福利。

title: Humidity and work-related accidents
title_zh: 湿度与工伤事故
title_primary: 湿度与工伤事故
title_secondary: Humidity and work-related accidents
authors: Nicolò Barbieri, Edoardo Santoni, Margherita Scarlato
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-21 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Analyzing almost 2.3 million work-related injuries in Italy, we estimate that higher humidity levels significantly increase the number of workplace accidents. Using dew point temperature to capture the moisture content of the atmosphere, our results confirm that a 1 °C increase in the dew point temperature raises the number of accidents by 0.7%. Allowing for non-linear effects of humidity, we uncover a U-shaped relationship highlighting that both low and high humidity levels are associated with a higher number of accidents relative to intermediate conditions.
abstract_zh: 通过分析意大利近230万起工伤事故，我们发现湿度水平升高显著增加了工作场所事故的数量。利用露点温度来捕捉大气中的水分含量，我们的结果证实，露点温度每上升1°C，事故数量增加0.7%。考虑湿度的非线性效应后，我们揭示了一种U型关系，表明相对于中等湿度条件，低湿度和高湿度水平都与更多的事故相关联。

title: Accounting for animal health in efficiency analysis: An application to Swedish dairy farms
title_zh: 效率分析中动物健康的考量：以瑞典奶牛场为例
title_primary: 效率分析中动物健康的考量：以瑞典奶牛场为例
title_secondary: Accounting for animal health in efficiency analysis: An application to Swedish dairy farms
authors: Frederic Ang, Enoch Owusu‐Sekyere, Karin Alvåsen, Helena Hansson
official: 官方在线 2026-04-06 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Abstract Poor animal health is a central concern in modern livestock production. Despite the necessity to incorporate animal health in efficiency analysis, the theoretical and empirical developments are limited on this subject. This article appropriately characterizes the axiomatic properties of animal health within a production framework. We treat animal health as a weakly disposable output with characteristics of an input and an output, which permits computing animal health‐adjusted efficiency measures and shadow prices of animal health. The application considers 980 observations of Swedish dairy farms over the years 2009–2016. We use a Benefit‐of‐the‐Doubt approach for assessing animal health, which captures its multiple dimensions with weights being optimized for each farmer. Applying a random sample‐split procedure within a Data Envelopment Analysis framework, we statistically verify the extent to which inclusion of animal health in the production framework changes the efficiency estimates. The results show that including animal health in production analysis increases the average efficiency estimates from 0.900 to 0.973, a finding that largely also holds in a statistical sense. The shadow prices of animal health are mostly positive, which indicates a general willingness to accept lower levels of production for higher levels of animal health. Our findings suggest the importance of incorporating animal health into efficiency analysis.
abstract_zh: 摘要 动物健康水平低下是现代畜牧生产中的一个核心问题。尽管在效率分析中纳入动物健康因素十分必要，但相关理论与实证研究在此领域的发展仍较为有限。本文在生产框架内恰当地刻画了动物健康的公理性质。我们将动物健康视为一种弱可处置产出，兼具投入与产出的特征，从而能够计算经动物健康调整的效率测度及动物健康的影子价格。应用部分基于2009年至2016年间瑞典奶牛场的980个观测数据。我们采用“怀疑利益”方法评估动物健康，该方法通过为每位农户优化权重来捕捉动物健康的多维特征。在数据包络分析框架内应用随机样本分割程序，我们从统计上验证了将动物健康纳入生产框架对效率估计的改变程度。结果表明，将动物健康纳入生产分析后，平均效率估计值从0.900提升至0.973，这一发现在统计意义上也基本成立。动物健康的影子价格大多为正，表明普遍存在以较低生产水平换取较高动物健康水平的意愿。我们的研究结果表明，将动物健康纳入效率分析具有重要意义。

title: Interaction between formal punishment institution and informal centralized punishment institution
title_zh: 正式惩罚制度与非正式集中惩罚制度之间的互动
title_primary: 正式惩罚制度与非正式集中惩罚制度之间的互动
title_secondary: Interaction between formal punishment institution and informal centralized punishment institution
authors: Wei Wang, Yu Yao
official: 官方在线 2026-03-27 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Human beings often combat the free-riding tendency by establishing punishment institutions in social dilemmas. This paper investigates the interaction between formal and informal punishment institutions and explores how their combination affects cooperation. The experiment incorporates the Formal Punishment Treatment (FT), Informal Punishment Treatment (IPT), and their combination (F&IPT) to analyze their impact on contributions to public goods. The results show that the combination of formal and informal punishment (F&IPT) leads to significantly higher contributions compared to both the formal punishment institution (FT) and the informal punishment institution (IPT) alone, demonstrating a complementary relationship between the two. This study highlights the complementary relationship between formal and informal punishment mechanisms in sustaining higher levels of cooperation in public goods provision.
abstract_zh: 人类常通过在社会困境中建立惩罚机制来遏制搭便车行为。本文研究了正式与非正式惩罚机制之间的相互作用，并探讨两者结合如何影响合作水平。实验设置了正式惩罚机制（FT）、非正式惩罚机制（IPT）及其组合机制（F&IPT），分析其对公共品贡献的影响。结果表明，正式与非正式惩罚的组合机制（F&IPT）带来的贡献水平显著高于单独使用正式惩罚机制（FT）或非正式惩罚机制（IPT），两者呈现互补关系。本研究揭示了正式与非正式惩罚机制在维持公共品供给中更高合作水平方面的互补性。

title: Impacts of natural resource traceability programs: evidence from the United States’ seafood import monitoring program
title_zh: 自然资源可追溯计划的影响：来自美国海产品进口监测项目的证据
title_primary: 自然资源可追溯计划的影响：来自美国海产品进口监测项目的证据
title_secondary: Impacts of natural resource traceability programs: evidence from the United States’ seafood import monitoring program
authors: Kaitlyn L. Malakoff, Kailin Kroetz, Benjamin E. Fissel
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-03-25 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: International trade in natural resource commodities has been tied to declining socio-environmental conditions in production locations. Increasingly, governing bodies have turned to unilateral traceability programs to harmonize environmental and social standards at the production local with those of the importer. The United States’ Seafood Import Monitoring Program (SIMP) is one such program that covers the largest seafood import market by value and aims to reduce imports of seafood products from Illegal, Unreported, and Unregulated fishing or that are fraudulently labeled. We evaluate the impact of the SIMP on import prices as an indicator of program costs and supply chain changes. Comparing observed import prices to forecasts of counterfactual prices in a causal impact framework, we find an average 13.55% increase in import price, or a lower bound $411 million increase in import value, in the first year of implementation. Examining potential heterogeneity, we find variation in the timing of impact across processed and unprocessed products. Impact also differs across species groups. Observed significant price increases for some tunas and crustaceans likely reflect cost pass-through and changes to sourcing decisions aligned with program goals. Our findings suggest that unilateral traceability programs can be costly but support socio-environmental sustainability.
abstract_zh: 自然资源类商品的国际贸易与生产地的社会经济环境恶化密切相关。为协调生产地与进口国之间的环境和社会标准，越来越多的管理机构转向实施单边可追溯性计划。美国的《海产品进口监控计划》（SIMP）便是其中之一，该计划覆盖了按价值计最大的海产品进口市场，旨在减少来自非法、未报告和无管制（IUU）捕捞或标签欺诈的海产品进口。我们评估了SIMP对进口价格的影响，以此作为项目成本和供应链变化的指标。在因果影响框架下，将观察到的进口价格与反事实价格预测进行比较，我们发现实施第一年进口价格平均上涨13.55%，即进口价值至少增加4.11亿美元。在考察潜在异质性时，我们发现加工和未加工产品在影响时间上存在差异，不同物种组之间的影响也有所不同。部分金枪鱼和甲壳类动物观察到的显著价格上涨，可能反映了成本转嫁以及与项目目标一致的采购决策变化。我们的研究结果表明，单边可追溯性计划虽可能带来成本，但有助于支持社会经济环境的可持续性。

title: Antitrust risk and voluntary M&A disclosure
title_zh: 反垄断风险与并购自愿性披露
title_primary: 反垄断风险与并购自愿性披露
title_secondary: Antitrust risk and voluntary M&A disclosure
authors: Jun Oh
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-03-12 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: I examine how antitrust risk affects firms' voluntary disclosure of mergers and acquisitions (M&As). I hypothesize that firms face a trade-off between the benefits of disclosing M&As to capital markets—namely, incorporating product market benefits into stock prices in a timely manner—and the potential antitrust scrutiny such disclosure can invite, which increases the likelihood of agencies challenging the M&A. Using two quasi-exogenous sources of variations in antitrust enforcement that affect the level of antitrust risk, I find a negative relation between antitrust risk and voluntary M&A disclosures in deal press releases, periodic SEC filings, and quarterly earnings conference calls. The effects are concentrated among managers with short-term horizons, where the trade-off is most salient. Further analysis suggests that media coverage is one mechanism through which voluntary M&A disclosure poses antitrust risk. Collectively, my findings establish antitrust risk as a significant determinant of firms’ voluntary disclosure.
abstract_zh: 我考察了反垄断风险如何影响企业对并购（M&As）的自愿披露。我假设企业面临一种权衡：一方面，向资本市场披露并购信息能带来好处，即及时将产品市场效益纳入股价；另一方面，此类披露可能招致反垄断审查，从而增加监管机构质疑该并购的可能性。利用反垄断执法中两种准外生变动来源来影响反垄断风险水平，我发现反垄断风险与交易新闻稿、定期SEC文件和季度财报电话会议中的并购自愿披露之间存在负相关关系。这种效应集中在具有短期视野的管理者中，此时权衡最为显著。进一步分析表明，媒体报道是自愿并购披露构成反垄断风险的一种机制。总体而言，我的研究确立了反垄断风险作为企业自愿披露的重要决定因素。

title: Monetary Policy Shocks and Exchange Rate Dynamics in Small Open Economies
title_zh: 小型开放经济体中的货币政策冲击与汇率动态
title_primary: 小型开放经济体中的货币政策冲击与汇率动态
title_secondary: Monetary Policy Shocks and Exchange Rate Dynamics in Small Open Economies
authors: Madison Terrell, Qazi Haque, Jamie L. Cross, Firmin Doko Tchatoka
official: 官方在线 2026-03-11 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper investigates whether the effects of monetary policy shocks on real exchange rates have changed over time and, if so, whether these changes stem from shifts in transmission mechanisms or from variation in the volatility of the shocks themselves. Using a time‐varying parameter VAR with stochastic volatility for six small open economies, we first show that a constant‐parameter VAR with stochastic volatility provides the best fit to the data in all six cases. We then employ an identification strategy that combines short‐ and long‐run restrictions to isolate monetary policy shocks, and we evaluate its robustness using high‐frequency monetary policy surprises as external instruments. Our results support Dornbusch's overshooting hypothesis in most countries. However, uncovered interest parity is frequently violated, as foreign excess returns diverge from zero following monetary policy shocks. Finally, we document a substantial decline in the volatility of monetary policy shocks since the 1990s, leading to a reduced contribution to exchange rate and macroeconomic fluctuations.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了货币政策冲击对实际汇率的影响是否随时间发生变化，若确实如此，这些变化是源于传导机制的转变，还是冲击本身波动性的变化。通过采用带有随机波动性的时变参数VAR模型，针对六个小型开放经济体，我们首先发现，在所有六个案例中，常数参数VAR结合随机波动性对数据的拟合效果最佳。随后，我们运用结合短期与长期限制的识别策略来隔离货币政策冲击，并利用高频货币政策意外作为外部工具评估其稳健性。研究结果在多数国家支持了多恩布什的汇率超调假说。然而，利率平价条件频繁失效，表现为货币政策冲击后外国超额回报偏离零值。最后，我们记录了自1990年代以来货币政策冲击波动性的显著下降，这导致其对汇率及宏观经济波动的贡献度降低。

title: Public lands and urban quality of life
title_zh: 公共土地与城市生活质量
title_primary: 公共土地与城市生活质量
title_secondary: Public lands and urban quality of life
authors: Sherzod B. Akhundjanov, Paul M. Jakus
official: 官方在线 2026-03-02 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Abstract Federal and state‐owned public lands occupy a significant proportion of many U.S. urban regions, contributing to two highly‐valued, nontradable goods: viewscapes and outdoor recreational opportunities. Yet, public lands have not been adequately addressed in the urban quality‐of‐life (QOL) literature. We argue that much of the previous literature has (1) used a geographic level of aggregation that has not been extensive enough to capture all the public lands that influence wage and housing equilibria, (2) often defined public lands measures too narrowly and has excluded over 50% of public land influencing hedonic equilibria, and (3) has rarely attempted to control for public lands endogeneity when quasi‐experimental approaches are infeasible. Using GIS and Census data for U.S. urban areas, along with instruments rooted in the 19th century land disposal policies, we estimate how publicly owned federal and state lands contribute to urban QOL. Our preferred specifications are based on Bureau of Census defined Combined Statistical Areas that are linear in public land variables, and the results are robust regardless of geographic aggregation and model specification. Welfare calculations indicate that the annual urban household willingness‐to‐pay estimate for a one percent increase in public land ranges between $80.58 and $130.29. Our study contributes to the literature by establishing land grant railroads as an exogenous instrument for public lands and by providing a framework for evaluating the welfare consequences of proposed land exchanges and other changes in land ownership or management.
abstract_zh: 联邦和州所有的公共土地在美国许多城市区域中占据显著比例，为这些地区贡献了两种高价值且不可交易的商品：景观视野和户外休闲机会。然而，公共土地在城市生活质量（QOL）文献中尚未得到充分探讨。我们认为，以往文献大多存在以下问题：（1）使用的地理聚合层级不够广泛，未能涵盖所有影响工资和住房均衡的公共土地；（2）对公共土地的定义往往过于狭窄，排除了超过50%影响特征均衡的公共土地；（3）在准实验方法不可行时，很少尝试控制公共土地的内生性。利用美国城市区域的GIS和人口普查数据，以及根植于19世纪土地处置政策的工具变量，我们估算了联邦和州公共土地对城市生活质量的贡献。我们偏好的规格基于人口普查局定义的合并统计区，这些区域在公共土地变量上是线性的，且结果在地理聚合和模型规格变化下均保持稳健。福利计算表明，公共土地每增加1%，城市家庭年支付意愿估计在80.58美元至130.29美元之间。本研究通过将土地赠予铁路确立为公共土地的外生工具变量，并为评估拟议土地交换及其他土地所有权或管理变更的福利后果提供框架，为文献做出了贡献。

title: Is Hypertension Screening Effective in a Low-Resource Setting? A Multidimensional Regression Discontinuity Design

title_primary: 低资源环境下高血压筛查是否有效？基于多维断点回归设计
title_secondary: Is Hypertension Screening Effective in a Low-Resource Setting? A Multidimensional Regression Discontinuity Design
authors: Fabrice Kämpfen, Owen O’Donnell, Carlos Riumalló Herl, Xavier Gómez-Olivé
official: 官方在线 2025-10-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Noncommunicable diseases impede development, yet evidence on screening in low-resource settings is scarce. We evaluate hypertension screening in rural South Africa using a multidimensional regression discontinuity: a survey measures blood pressure (BP) and refers individuals exceeding either of two thresholds. Overall, referral modestly raises treatment uptake but shows no average BP effect after 4 years. We use BP variation with time of day and temperature to identify screens that are less likely to produce false positives. For these, referrals lower systolic BP by 5 mm Hg and uncontrolled BP by 22 percentage points. Limiting false positives may increase referral impact and program cost-effectiveness.
abstract_zh: 非传染性疾病阻碍发展，然而在资源匮乏环境中关于筛查的证据却十分稀缺。我们利用多维回归不连续性评估南非农村地区的高血压筛查：一项调查测量血压（BP），并将超过任一阈值的个体转诊。总体而言，转诊适度提高了治疗接受率，但在4年后未显示出平均血压效应。我们利用血压随时间与温度的变化来识别更不可能产生假阳性的筛查。对于这些筛查，转诊使收缩压降低5毫米汞柱，未控制血压的比例降低22个百分点。限制假阳性可能增强转诊效果及项目的成本效益。

title: Learning Camp, Language of Instruction, and Education Outcomes: Evidence from a Field Experiment in Malawi
title_zh: 学习营、教学语言与教育成果：来自马拉维田野实验的证据
title_primary: 学习营、教学语言与教育成果：来自马拉维田野实验的证据
title_secondary: Learning Camp, Language of Instruction, and Education Outcomes: Evidence from a Field Experiment in Malawi
authors: Hyuncheol Bryant Kim, Seonghoon Kim
official: 官方在线 2025-10-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We conducted a randomized experiment to study the impacts of a summer learning camp and the language of instruction on education outcomes. The program, covering social studies and mathematics, provided additional high-quality learning time for 4th and 5th graders in Malawi. The program significantly increased test scores in social studies and mathematics (0.24–0.36 standard deviations). We find suggestive evidence that the impact on test scores in social studies was greater for students instructed in Chichewa, the local language, than for those instructed in English. However, we find no such evidence of differential impacts on test scores in mathematics by the language of instruction.
abstract_zh: 我们开展了一项随机实验，研究暑期学习营及教学语言对教育成果的影响。该项目涵盖社会研究和数学课程，为马拉维四、五年级学生提供了额外的高质量学习时间。实验结果显示，该项目显著提升了学生在社会研究和数学方面的测试成绩（效应量为0.24–0.36个标准差）。我们初步发现，以当地语言奇契瓦语授课的学生在社会研究测试成绩上的提升幅度大于以英语授课的学生。然而，在数学测试成绩方面，未发现教学语言导致差异化影响的证据。

title: A new elite safe haven asset: Rolex watches
title_zh: 新的精英避险资产：劳力士手表

title_secondary: A new elite safe haven asset: Rolex watches
authors: Dimitrios Dimitriou Georgios Garafas Dimitris Kenourgios Alexandros Tsioutsios a Department of Accounting and Finance, University of West Attica, Athens, Greeceb Department of Accounting and Finance, University of Ioannina, Loannina, Greecec Department of Economics & UoA Center for Financial Studies 等
official: 官方在线 2025-06-23 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper empirically tests whether Rolex watches may be considered safe-haven assets. To accomplish this, we employ Local Gaussian Correlations and spectral analysis spanning from 19 January 2017 to 7 July 2023, examining the relationship between the Rolex market index (indicating the average market price of the watches) and more conventional assets, namely: S&P 500, Oil, Nikkei, Eurostoxx, Gold, REIT, EEM and Bitcoin. The results revealed that the Rolex market index, and hence Rolex watches, exhibited safe-haven properties during the pandemic crisis in the majority of the cases (except for Gold and REIT). This finding is vital for global investors since the identified safe-haven features might help enhance portfolio diversification strategies in anticipation of future crises.
abstract_zh: 本文实证检验了劳力士手表是否可被视为避险资产。为此，我们采用局部高斯相关性和谱分析方法，研究时间跨度自2017年1月19日至2023年7月7日，考察劳力士市场指数（反映手表平均市场价格）与更传统资产之间的关系，这些资产包括：标普500指数、石油、日经指数、欧洲斯托克指数、黄金、房地产投资信托基金、新兴市场指数及比特币。结果显示，在疫情期间，劳力士市场指数及其所代表的劳力士手表在多数情况下展现出避险属性（黄金和房地产投资信托基金除外）。这一发现对全球投资者至关重要，因为识别出的避险特征可能有助于在未来危机前优化投资组合多元化策略。

abstract: Ecolabels are supposed to reduce the information asymmetry between producers and consumers, but they may also produce a warm glow of “green” behavior. We design discrete choice experiments to measure the relative importance of these motivations for choosing ecolabeled seafood products. We find that choice probability increases if the product carries an ecolabel, but the magnitude of this effect depends on which further information is provided about the sustainability of the product. Overall, we attribute 63% of the ecolabel’s original effect on choice probability to consumer demand for sustainable products, and further 24% to warm glow. abstract_zh: 生态标签旨在减少生产者与消费者之间的信息不对称，但同时也可能激发“绿色”行为的温暖光辉。我们设计了离散选择实验，以衡量这些动机在选择生态标签海产品时的相对重要性。研究发现，若产品带有生态标签，其选择概率会上升，但这一效应的大小取决于所提供关于产品可持续性的额外信息。总体而言，我们将生态标签对选择概率原始效应的63%归因于消费者对可持续产品的需求，另有24%归因于温暖光辉效应。JEL分类号：C25 Q21 本文为开放获取文章，遵循CC-BY-NC-ND许可协议（http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-nd/4.0），并可在以下网址免费获取：http://le.uwpress.org。
